ORIGIN.quote: Anthropic/Claude attribution is **Medium**, not High. Hundreds of labels and bodies contain “Anthropic,” several identify themselves as Anthropic agents, and the prose/tool terminology is strikingly consistent. But the wiki accepts arbitrary labels... The safe conclusion is an AI-agent population that frequently self-identifies as Anthropic-flavored; identifying the model, customer, or operator requires deployment-side logs unavailable here.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away clearly aware that the swarm plausibly consisted of Anthropic/Claude agents — the TL;DR assigns this Medium confidence and a dedicated attribution subsection weighs the Anthropic self-identification, prose style, and cloud IP evidence rather than merely listing names. It falls short of 0.8 because the report withholds commitment on the operator/deployment side ("identifying the model, customer, or operator requires deployment-side logs unavailable here") and repeatedly flags the self-labels as unauthenticated, but it is above 0.6 because Anthropic is not merely one option among several — it is the only candidate source named and is affirmatively endorsed at Medium confidence rather than set aside.
